entries.change: Repaired three original-catalog links to www.synsig.org (Speech Technology → Synthesis): the SIG's historical domain has been hijacked and now serves a gambling site while still answering HTTP 200, so the automated link check could not catch it. Entry text unchanged; repair registered in the coverage audit.

Merged the ISCA SIG activities atlas into this page as the 'ISCA SIGs & online events' part: 20 SIG cards with reviewed activities and video resources, the webinar & lecture series tracker, upcoming events, recorded workshop archives, ISCA-level video resources and board notes. The atlas's former standalone address now redirects here. All SIG links were reviewed 31 August 2026 (see 'The SIG part' in the footer).

Site name confirmed as SCOOT 2.0 (this rebuild supersedes the July 2026 SCOOT 2.0 prototype at the same address).

All 104 resource entries from the original SCOOT pages (26 pages, snapshot 2026-08-31) transcribed and preserved; the 2.0 curated catalog (118 entries) re-mapped as clearly-marked extensions under the original topics, plus three extension topics (Paralinguistics, Clinical & Accessibility, Community). Every link on the page re-verified; dead original links carry Internet Archive snapshot links. Daily-feed tab removed (auto-update paused 2026-08-28).
SCOOT 2.0 prototype launched: curated catalog seeded (all entries link-verified), daily auto-update pipeline for arXiv papers and trending models, community suggestion loop defined.
